programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, soldier Luc Deveraux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds that his superior officer, Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren), has turned violently deranged, and the two fight to the death. After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Deveraux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: Queen of the Damned
programme.desc: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat.

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon, having already defeated every army in Greece, uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy, the last kingdom preventing his control over the Aegean Sea.

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy.

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter closes in on a ruthless killer terrorizing the city, but a fleeting clue is all he has to go on; as Harrison settles into his new role at NYPD Homicide, mounting pressure, old rivals and dangerous suspects threaten to derail the hunt.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the 🏁 [NASCAR] Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes).

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: During the approach of the most powerful storm in decades, university professor Dr. Jo Harding (Helen Hunt) and an underfunded team of students prepares the prototype for Dorothy, a ground-breaking tornado data-gathering device conceived by her estranged husband, Bill (Bill Paxton). When Harding tells Bill that Dorothy is ready for testing -- and that their privately funded rival Dr. Jonas Miller (Cary Elwes) has stolen the idea and built his own -- Bill rejoins the team for one last mission.

programme.title: Reet, Petite and Gone

programme.title: Mystery Street
programme.desc: When bargirl Vivian (Jan Sterling) discovers that her married boyfriend has refused to leave his wife, she steals a car and drives to Cape Cod to confront him. Several months later her skeleton washes ashore, and local police officer Peter Moralas (Ricardo Montalban) must work with Harvard forensics expert Dr. McAdoo (Bruce Bennett) in order to piece together the twisted tale and discover who the murderer is before an innocent suspect pays the ultimate price.

programme.title: Bad Day at Black Rock
programme.desc: When John J. Macreedy (Spencer Tracy), a one-armed war veteran, arrives in the small desert town of Black Rock, he's not greeted warmly. Searching for a man named Komoko, Macreedy is met with disdain by virtually every local, including the resident thug, Hector David (Lee Marvin), and the imposing Reno Smith (Robert Ryan). As Macreedy's investigation deepens, hostility turns to violence -- and to imminent danger for the mysterious and inquisitive stranger.

programme.title: Edge of Doom
programme.desc: After the death of his ailing mother, Martin Lynn (Farley Granger) feels desperately alone. His only concern is that his mother receive an elegant burial. Unfortunately, Martin is also in a dire financial situation and cannot afford an expensive church service. Enraged, Martin viciously directs his frustrations at a clergyman, killing him. The impulsive act leaves Martin in an even more despondent state, though a kindly priest (Dana Andrews) may be able to guide the young man toward redemption.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals.

programme.title: Seven Days in May
programme.desc: U.S. President Jordan Lyman (Fredric March) hopes to bring an end to the Cold War by signing a nuclear disarmament treaty with the Soviets, much to the displeasure of the hawkish General James Scott (Burt Lancaster), Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. When Scott's aide, Martin "Jiggs" Casey (Kirk Douglas) stumbles on shattering evidence that the General is plotting a coup to overthrow Lyman in seven days, "Jiggs" alerts the President, setting off a dangerous race to thwart the takeover.

programme.title: The Swimmer
programme.desc: Well-off ad man Ned Merrill (Burt Lancaster) is visiting a friend when he notices the abundance of backyard pools that populate their upscale suburb. Ned suddenly decides that he'd like to travel the eight miles back to his own home by simply swimming across every pool in town. Soon, Ned's journey becomes harrowing; at each house, he is somehow confronted with a reminder of his romantic, domestic and economic failures, until a final visit with an old flame (Janice Rule) leaves him devastated.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band whether they should honor their agreement.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Sentenced to life in solitary confinement after killing a prison guard, despondent inmate Robert Stroud (Burt Lancaster) combats loneliness and tedium by nursing an ailing bird back to health. Stroud develops an interest in caring for birds and becomes a talented ornithologist. After publishing a book on bird diseases from jail, he meets and marries Stella (Betty Field), a fellow bird enthusiast. When Stroud is suddenly moved to Alcatraz, though, his marriage and work are both threatened.

programme.title: Elmer Gantry
programme.desc: When hedonistic but charming con man Elmer Gantry (Burt Lancaster) meets the beautiful Sister Sharon Falconer (Jean Simmons), a roadside revivalist, he feigns piousness to join her act as a passionate preacher. The two make a successful onstage pair, and their chemistry extends to romance. Both the show and their relationship are threatened, however, when one of Gantry's ex-lovers (Shirley Jones) decides that she has a score to settle with the charismatic performer.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: With the Allies poised to retake Paris from the Germans, Col. Franz Von Waldheim (Paul Scofield) conspires to sneak out by train all the art masterpieces looted by the German army. But museum curator Mademoiselle Villard (Suzanne Flon) alerts the French Resistance, and soon railway inspector Paul Labiche (Burt Lancaster) is pressed into service. He reroutes the train, and cleverly deceives Von Waldheim by renaming each train station along the way.

programme.title: The Gypsy Moths
programme.desc: Three men who work in a skydiving performance group -- burned-out Mike (Burt Lancaster), outgoing showman Joe (Gene Hackman) and rookie Malcolm (Scott Wilson) -- find work in a small Kansas town and lodging at the home of Malcolm's Uncle John (William Windom) and Aunt Elizabeth (Deborah Kerr). The couple are in the midst of a marital crisis, and when Elizabeth meets the dashing Mike, everyone is surprised by their passionate and dangerous love affair.

programme.title: Princess O'Rourke
programme.desc: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: The young Austrian princess Marie Antoinette (Norma Shearer) is arranged to marry Louis XVI (Robert Morley), future king of France, in a politically advantageous marriage for the rival countries. The opulent Marie indulges in various whims and flirtations, including Count Axel (Tyrone Power). When Louis XV (John Barrymore) passes and Louis XVI ascends the French throne, his queen's extravagant lifestyle earns the hatred of the French people, who despise her Austrian heritage.

programme.title: The Swan
programme.desc: Prince Albert, who is scouring Europe for a wife, arrives in a tiny town to visit a banished family of nobles. Their matriarch, Beatrix, wants her daughter, Alexandra, to marry Albert so that her family will be welcomed back into the kingdom. In order to rouse Albert's attention, Alexandra flirts with her attractive tutor, Dr. Agi; however, Alexandra's plan hits a snag when she develops genuine feelings for Dr. Agi.

programme.title: Her Highness and the Bellboy
programme.desc: A New York hotel bellboy (Robert Walker) forgets his girlfriend (June Allyson) after meeting a European princess (Hedy Lamarr).

programme.title: The Glass Slipper
programme.desc: In a retelling of the "Cinderella" tale, young orphan Ella (Leslie Caron) lives with her unpleasant stepmother (Elsa Lanchester) and stepsisters (Amanda Blake, Lisa Daniels), essentially working as their housekeeper. When the local prince (Michael Wilding) returns from school, a ball is announced. Around that time, Ella meets the prince, who is disguised as the son of the palace chef, and the two fall in love. When she manages to attend the ball, his revealed identity causes quite a stir.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Manuela Alva is unhappily engaged to Don Pedro, the mayor of her town. When a circus arrives, she's enchanted by performer Serafin, who's likewise smitten with her. The mayor tries to evict the circus from town, but Serafin turns the tables after realizing Don Pedro is Macoco, an ex-pirate in hiding. When Serafin learns that Manuela dreams of Macoco, he adopts the discarded identity to woo her — but is then condemned to death for the pirate's crimes.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: This adventure-filled drama finds Englishman Rudolf Rassendyll (Ronald Colman) on vacation in a small European country, where he discovers his resemblance to the nation's royal heir-apparent, Rudolf V. When the king-to-be is drugged and incapacitated, Rassendyll must impersonate him, so that the scheming Duke Michael (Raymond Massey) can't assume the throne. To further complicate matters, Rassendyll starts to fall for Rudolf V's intended bride, Flavia (Madeleine Carroll).

programme.title: Edge of Eternity
programme.desc: Widowed Les Martin is an ex-detective haunted by a case he left behind in Denver. Now, Martin is the deputy sheriff of a small Arizona town with nothing to do but pull over beautiful local socialite Janice Kendon for occasional speeding -- until a mysterious murder at a nearby ghost town requires him to put his old skills to use once again. With the help of Sheriff Edwards and Kendon, Martin must unravel a murderous plot involving stolen gold.

programme.title: Easy Rider

On their journey, they experience bigotry and hatred from the inhabitants of small-town America and also meet with other travelers seeking alternative lifestyles. After a terrifying drug experience in New Orleans, the two travelers wonder if they will ever find a way to live peacefully in America.

After their drought-ridden farm is seized by the bank, the family -- led by just-paroled son Tom -- loads up a truck and heads West. On the road, beset by hardships, the Joads meet dozens of other families making the same trek and holding onto the same dream. programme.title: The Cinema List: Christmas Classics
programme.desc: It's the most wonderful time of the year! From the Grinch's Christmas mischief to the romance of 'Last Christmas', celebrate the season with our festive Cinema List.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

programme.title: Christmas With the Kranks
programme.desc: Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Nothing seems to go right for a frustrated Londoner who works as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop. But things soon take a turn for the better when she develops a growing attraction to a charming suitor who seems too good to be true.

programme.title: My Christmas Cowboy
programme.desc: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, they reunite in a small Texas town to save an annual holiday event.

programme.title: Tinsel Town
programme.desc: A washed-up Hollywood action hero takes a role in a small English village's quirky Christmas pantomime, where he finds unexpected inspiration through the show's straight-talking dance instructor.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.

programme.title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
programme.desc: An amnesiac schoolteacher discovers she was formerly a government assassin when she hires a low-rent private eye to help fill the gaps in her memory. Together, they go on the run in a race against the clock to stop her former taskmasters from putting a heinous plan into action, before they can silence her for good.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Christmas With the Kranks
programme.desc: Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.

programme.title: White Christmas
programme.desc: Two army buddies who have become entertainers travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest. However, on arrival they find the resort, run by their old army commander, in need of a helping hand. There's only one answer, to put on a show.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve 1850, and the melancholy Scrooge finds himself alone at home when he sees before him the ghost of Jacob Marley, his long-time friend and business partner who died seven years earlier. Marley warns Scrooge that he will repent, even in death, for all the suffering he has caused others, and he has only one chance to escape his fate.

programme.desc: Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit. Come December, the only one smiling is the Grinch, who's stolen everyone's presents. However, a little girl sees some good in the furry grouch, so there may be a merry Christmas after all.

programme.title: Scrooged
programme.desc: Three ghosts give a greedy network executive a long-overdue attitude adjustment over the Christmas period. Based on the Charles Dickens classic, 'A Christmas Carol'.

programme.desc: Weaving in and out of the love lives of eight loosely inter-related couples. The bachelor Prime Minister falls for his personal assistant, his brother-in-law is flirting with one of his colleagues, a writer heads off to France and pursues an affair with a maid, and an 11-year-old boy asks his father for advice on matters of the heart.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: An LA record producer returns to his New Jersey hometown ten years after being rejected by his high-school cheerleader crush. Having made the transformation from no-hope geek to Greek god womaniser and with his friend still single, he embarks on a second seduction strategy that does not always go to plan.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Clark Griswold sets out to give his family a traditional Christmas. While his in-laws, among them a cousin from hell, sample his hospitality, they find themselves battling against rabid squirrels, and an exploding sewer to achieve a family Christmas that they will never forget.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas
programme.desc: At Christmas, rich loser Drew takes a nostalgic trip out to his old family house. Drew doesn't have anywhere to go for the holidays, so he persuades the family now living in the house to put him up, for a handsome fee, of course.

programme.desc: Noah explores The Mammoth Site in Hot Springs, South Dakota. He’ll explore this amazing site, where over one hundred mammoths have been preserved in the sediments in an ancient sinkhole. He’ll find out how genetics can explain where the mammoths came from after the global Flood, why radio carbon dating can only give us accurate dates of a few thousand years, and how they could have reproduced so quickly after coming off the ark. programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants

programme.desc: The Concours d'Elegance from Amelia Island: Featuring bomb-proof Conquest Knight XV, '69 Camaro Hagerty Fixer-Upper, and car-enthusiast John Oates.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengance - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Andrew Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: C&O at the Beach - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Kenny Roger's Family Values - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "The Old, the Bold and the Newborn"
programme.sub-title: The Old, the Bold and the Newborn
programme.desc: A 17-year-old cat, a bulldog with a mystery swelling, newborn pups, and a mischievous puppy test the Blue Cross team’s skill and compassion.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Accidents, Surgeries and Fearful Friends"
programme.desc: The team springs into action for a a puppy hit by car, Westie's unusual surgery and a Staffordshire that fears fireworks.

programme.title: Camp Raiders
programme.desc: Meet the 'Trash Can Clan' doing their daily round of the dustbins in South Africa's most famour national park, the Kruger.

programme.title: Quolls: Fast & Furious

programme.title: Frontier Vets S1 - "Tough Day at the Office"
programme.desc: The vets get situated in their dormitory accommodations. Dr. Greg deliberately pairs them according to their differences. Vets need to learn to work with colleagues and clients different from themselves.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Lydia Moecklinghoff"
programme.desc: Lydia Möcklinghoff, a renowned anteater researcher, has dedicated her life to the protection and study of these fascinating creatures.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Stadiums: Stunning Arenas"
programme.desc: Sports stadiums are widely considered architectural treasures, on par with shrines, cathedrals and other important monuments.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Memorials and Monuments: Built in Honor"
programme.sub-title: Memorials and Monuments: Built in Honor

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "City Squares: Amazing and Never Still"
programme.sub-title: City Squares: Amazing and Never Still
programme.desc: City squares have distinctive characters and often play a major role in enriching and enhancing the cultures of their cities.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Parks and Gardens: Paradise Created by Humans"
programme.sub-title: Parks and Gardens: Paradise Created by Humans
programme.desc: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes"
programme.sub-title: Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes
programme.desc: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Theatres and Opera Houses: Unforgettable Experiences"
programme.sub-title: Theatres and Opera Houses: Unforgettable Experiences
programme.desc: Theaters and opera houses are wonders of stage technology, as well as exquisite masterpieces of modern or historic architecture.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Message From Space?"
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of West Virginia, the Green Bank Observatory has been receiving a mysterious signal from deep space. Could this be message from an advanced civilization, or is it a much stranger and violent occurrence?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "African Animal Rescue"
programme.desc: The staff of South Africa's Manyoni Private Game Reserve passionately care for some of the world's most exotic and endangered wild animals. From treating elephant foot infections to testing cheetahs for tuberculosis, they never know what to expect.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "What Makes a Planet?"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at many objects that, regardless of definition, look like new and fascinating planets.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "A Space Station for All"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores what kind of experiments are being conducted on the International Space Station that will benefit humans on earth.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Mars vs. the Moon"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli investigates this dilemma which will determine our space-faring future.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Landing on Mars"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at the varied and ingenious methods used to land spacecraft on the red planet, starting with Pathfinder in 1997.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Speed"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell climbs aboard some of the world’s fastest theme park rides and learns what it takes to build them.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Falling"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell discovers how our fear of falling is exploited by some of the world’s top theme park rides.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Height"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell climbs aboard four spectacular rollercoasters in Europe and America that exploit our fear of heights.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Inversion"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four roller coasters in Europe and America that use inversions, or loops, to create thrilling rides.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Chainsaws, Jukeboxes, and Fishing Reels"
programme.desc: Chainsaw, jukebox, fishing reel, car wash, blender and bicycle pump... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Escalators, Leaf Blowers, and Music Boxes"
programme.sub-title: Escalators, Leaf Blowers, and Music Boxes
programme.desc: Escalator, leaf blower, tape measure, security safe, tennis ball launcher, music box... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Polynesian Volcanoes"
programme.desc: Filming the volcanoes, mudpools and geysers in the geothermic wonderland of New Zealand’s north island, we learn that a new island is being created by an undersea volcano 1000 miles north in Tonga.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Highway to Hell"
programme.desc: George heads straight into the “Bearcage”, looking to get beat up by the biggest, baddest hailstones that Texas and Oklahoma can throw at them. He finds it –and the stormchasing vehicles don’t look too pretty after coming through these massive storms.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Space"
programme.desc: We break the bounds of earth, and look at the environment of space. We examine the difficulties and challenges of exploring this most challenging environment.

programme.title: Exceptional Engineering S1 - "Emergency Helicopter"
programme.desc: In Bavaria, engineers build the high-tech H145 rescue helicopter, while skilled pilots navigate extreme terrain to save lives.

programme.title: Exceptional Engineering S1 - "Harvesting Giants"
programme.desc: Inside the Fendt factory, advanced GPS technology and complex assembly lines create the world's most powerful 517-hp agricultural tractor.

programme.title: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Elegance of Iron"
programme.desc: Industrial Revolution innovations in iron, steel, and railway construction spawn truss and suspension designs capable of spanning vast divides.

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Color"
programme.desc: In this episode we'll understand how chromatic adaptation works, how do we see the color pink and why do blue rarely exists in nature.

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Problems"
programme.desc: A lot of problems in this episode. What is the Birthday Problem? Why the Gambler's Ruin debunks the 'luck' factor? And is the union of two sets with infinite elements still be infinity?

programme.title: Strange World S1 - "Ice Bombs"
programme.desc: Alex heads to America search of a scientific explanation for the terrifying phenomenon known as Ice Bombs, which cause fear, devastation and even injury.

programme.title: Strange World S1 - "Alien Sounds"
programme.desc: Mysterious, alien sky sounds terrify Canadian residents, who struggle to locate their source.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Living Virtually"
programme.desc: How did the invention of photography lead us to a world where we live entirely virtually? Alie Ward will point us towards a future where we might upload ourselves to the web.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Kapap - Amit Himelstein"
programme.desc: Amit Himelstein is the head instructor of the IKF and the leader in Kapap. His big motto? Respect everyone but fear no-one. He’s the embodiment of krav maga.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Imaging the Aurora"
programme.desc: Reya El-Salahi explores how the northern lights can disrupt technology and visits EISCAT 3D, a new radar studying solar particle impacts.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Long COVID"
programme.desc: Emma meets Dr. Asad Khan, whose life was upended by long COVID, as new research seeks answers for millions still suffering worldwide.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Rewilding Bison"
programme.desc: Emma Keeling treks through Romania’s Tarcu Mountains to see how European bison, once extinct in the wild, are making a comeback.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - ""The Way" to Fusion"
programme.desc: Neil Cairns visits ITER in France, where nuclear fusion could provide unlimited clean energy, to see progress and challenges firsthand.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Urban Microbiome"
programme.desc: Research shows sanitized cities reduce beneficial microbes, harming health and increasing allergies and autoimmune diseases.

programme.title: Future Warfare S1 - "Artificial Intelligence & Autonomy"
programme.desc: As military algorithms outpace human capability, experts explore the risks and ethical choices of deploying fully autonomous weapon systems.

programme.title: Future Warfare S1 - "Cyber Warfare"
programme.desc: Virtual attacks replace traditional battlefields, showing how hackers target critical infrastructure, data, and governments without physical force.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programme.desc: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programme.sub-title: Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies
programme.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programme.sub-title: Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf
programme.desc: Exploring the historic Lea & Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its legendary Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837. He then heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, home of the beloved malt loaf, where he joins the production line and experiments with creating a new flavour.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish"
programme.sub-title: Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish
programme.desc: To discover how his favourite meal—fish supper followed by rice pudding—is made, Lord Prescott visits the Ambrosia factory in Devon to explore the production of classic British desserts. Returning north to Grimsby, he heads to the Young's factory to learn about their famous fish pie.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Typhoo Tea and Fox's biscuits"
programme.desc: In search of the classic British pairing, tea and biscuits, Lord Prescott travels to Liverpool to visit the Typhoo tea factory, discovering the key to a perfectly brewed cup. Back in Yorkshire, he stops by the Fox’s biscuits factory, rounding off his journey with a truly British treat.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ribena and Tyrells"
programme.desc: Taking a nostalgic journey to rediscover two of his childhood favourites, Lord Prescott visits the Ribena factory to see how their famous blackcurrant squash is made, using 90% of the UK's blackcurrant crop. In Herefordshire, he explores the Tyrrells crisp factory to learn how a small farm-based business turns homegrown potatoes into gourmet crisps.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Earliest Arenas: The Colosseum"
programme.desc: Since their earliest existence in ancient Greek and Roman civilizations, stadiums have been regarded as achitectural masterpieces and focal poins in their surrounding cities, but none more so than the Colosseum in Rome.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "How Gold Changed The World"
programme.desc: Join us as we dig deep in this episode to uncover how gold was mined and transformed into everyday objects like jewellery and currency, and even to adorn holy temples and statues.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Deadliest Weapons"
programme.desc: As the battle distance continued to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millenia to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Navigating The Globe"
programme.desc: This episode dives into the pioneering breakthroughs from across the globe that have shaped our ability to travel.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Tools & Tech"
programme.desc: Delve into the history of technology; from a simple rock to the invention of modern computing.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Anatomy of the House"
programme.desc: From living in caves to grand mansions, shelter has always been high on the list of our priorities. Bur form and function varies wildly throughout civilizations.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Extreme Buildings"
programme.desc: Throughout history, our ancestors have always strived to go higher, bigger, deeper, further - and this is reflected in the buildings and structures around our globe. But what secrets can these ancient structures reveal?

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Hidden Marvels"
programme.desc: This episode explores some of history's most ingenious, yet lesser-known engineering solutions.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Ancient Waterways"
programme.desc: The ancient ancestors realized that building structures and machines to harness water to provide transport, power, drainage and irrigation was vital to the success of their civilizations.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Building Bridges"
programme.desc: Our ancient ancestors had to come up with ingenious solutions and structures to travel freely - over the hills, valleys and rivers of our world.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Impossible Ice"
programme.desc: A family in Saskatchewan call in a team of ice road truckers to haul their 3-storey wooden home across a frozen lake.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Supersize Station"
programme.desc: A family in Saskatchewan calls in a crew of house haulers to move an ornate railway station across the state so they can transform it into a dream home.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Pacific Palace"
programme.desc: A family in Vancouver calls in a crew of house truckers to haul a beautiful two-storey house across land and water so they can have a bigger home.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Harbour House"
programme.desc: A couple in Vancouver call in a crew of marine engineers to build and sail a beautiful floating house down the Fraser River and out to sea, to get to their moorings.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Floating Fortress"
programme.desc: A family hires a team of marine engineers in Vancouver to build and sail an enormous floating home down a busy river to reach their moorings.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "River Rescue"
programme.desc: A family in Washington state hires a crew of house truckers to rescue their beloved home that is about to fall off the edge of a crumbling cliff into a raging river.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Minnesota Family Farmhouse"
programme.desc: A family in Minnesota hire a team of house truckers to move their historic farmstead closer to work to eliminate their daily commutes.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Million Dollar Mansion"
programme.desc: The Pilcher family in Saskatchewan call in a team of house truckers to haul their stunning mansion across rough fields and down narrow lanes to save it from being demolished.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Hawaii House Chop"
programme.desc: A team of house truckers in Hawaii move a stunning house to a new plot of land for an entrepreneur in Honolulu.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Runway Race"
programme.desc: A family in St Cloud, Minnesota call in a team of house movers to move a beautiful two-storey home, destined to be their son’s first home, to rescue it from the wrecking ball.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Colossal Cabin"
programme.desc: A family in Greenville, Florida calls in a team of house haulers to move their much-loved holiday log cabin along a treacherous route to a new site.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Risky Rescue"
programme.desc: A family in Silex, Missouri call in a team of heavy haulers to rescue their treasured home from a waterlogged flood plain.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Historic House"
programme.desc: A family in Calgary call in a team of house truckers to move a historic colonial house to help give them – and their five children – more living space.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "The Science of Cute"
programme.desc: Domestication shaped wolves into dogs and transformed both their behavior and their anatomy. New discoveries show how dogs produce a very specific eyebrow movement more often than wolves do.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: The rains have arrived, and the desert has never looked better. Cleo, the boss of this group of wild meerkats has given birth to five new pups, but some of them quickly get lost or snatched away. Only the toughest survive here in the African desert.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: In another cruel twist, Cleo’s young pup Ophelia got left behind on a foraging trip and was killed by one of the Kalahari’s most dangerous creatures, a Goshawk. The remaining three pups: Zeus, Daisy and Flo struggle to survive.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: The Gosa Gang have recently moved to a new home, close to the Gosa Dam where a rival family of meerkats live. In the quest for territorial dominance, a major meerkat standoff resulted in both gangs losing a member of their tribe.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: Recently Priscilla bought an adopted boy pup from a rival gang to the Gosa Burrow. Unfortunately, his acceptance into the Gosa group was far from ideal. The rest of the gang went out and he was left alone at the burrow, struggling for his life.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: Summer has arrived. The Gang move to an area known as the Whispering Forest as it is the best place to find food at this time of year. However, the grass is long and there are several predators lurking such as a leopard.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 6"
programme.desc: The Gosa Gang are on their way home from the Whispering Forest and bump head on into their bitter enemies. To get past them and move over the mountain a full-on war breaks out.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Responsible Fishing"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at the WWF Responsible Fisheries Programme. Dr. Samantha Petersen, the programme manager, tells exactly us what this entails and Tali dons her waterproofs and sets sail where she chats to fishermen and others in the industry.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "West Coast Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode we show just how valuable this marine protected area is.Tali meets up with a group of scientists who are doing various studies so that they can assess the fish stocks and look at what role the mpa has in managing these stocks.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "De Hoop Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode Tali explores the various creatures that reside in De Hoop Marine Protected Area, from the Greater White Pelicans and Chacma baboons to the large Eland.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Agulhas"
programme.desc: Cape Agulhas is the true meeting place of the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, a place of immense cultural and natural value. Tali searches for answers to her burning questions about establishing new parks and the roles communities play in this process.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cedarberg Biodiversity"
programme.desc: Using a novel conservation model, the Greater Cedarberg Biodiversity Initiative is ensuring that the land is used in an efficient way, with the land and its inhabitants work in harmony. Tali investigate the various ways being used to achieve this.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Floristic Region"
programme.desc: Tali investigates the struggle to protect the Cape Floristic Region, one of the world’s 6 floral kingdoms and the only one entirely within the borders of a single country. She finds out more about why this region is in critical need of conservation.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Working For Water"
programme.desc: In this episode we turn our attention to the damaging effects of invasive alien plants on our country’s water supply. Tali looks at three initiatives, Working for Wetlands; Working for Water and the Water Neutral Scheme.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Big Cats"
programme.desc: In this episode we meet the Big Cats. The zoo crew treats a tiger called Lolo with a toothache. Adrian and Jacquie rescue three teenage lion cubs from an illegal facility and transport them to their new home at City Zoo.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Rhino’s"
programme.desc: In this episode we learn to tell the difference between both the white and black rhino residents. Adrian and the zoo crew travel to the Lichtenburg Breeding centre to monitor a herd of white rhino.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "The Birds"
programme.desc: In this episode Cape Vultures are given a new lease on life. The zoo crew monitors the success of their Cape Vulture breeding program, so that this rare species endures.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Primates"
programme.desc: In this episode Adrian, the zoo vet, treats Lesser White monkey with a weight issue. The zoo's three chimpanzees have their annual health check and Adrian becomes concerned that the eldest female is showing signs of ill health.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Chainsaws, Jukeboxes, and Fishing Reels"
programme.desc: Chainsaw, jukebox, fishing reel, car wash, blender and bicycle pump... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.desc: Escalator, leaf blower, tape measure, security safe, tennis ball launcher, music box... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Lawnmowers, Pinball Machines and Padlocks"

programme.title: Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If you're in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, you'll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailand's endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. Check out one of the world's most beautiful ice caverns in Russia's Ural region or the wonder of the Northern Lights in Murmansk. RTD's nature documentaries also expose the manmade threats facing the environment today, from raw sewage in India's sacred Ganges River to plastic micro-bead pollution in the Caribbean Sea.

programme.title: Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If you're in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, you'll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailand's endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. Check out one of the world's most beautiful ice caverns in Russia's Ural region or the wonder of the Northern Lights in Murmansk. RTD's nature documentaries also expose the manmade threats facing the environment today, from raw sewage in India's sacred Ganges River to plastic micro-bead pollution in the Caribbean Sea.

programme.title: Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If you're in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, you'll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailand's endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. Check out one of the world's most beautiful ice caverns in Russia's Ural region or the wonder of the Northern Lights in Murmansk. RTD's nature documentaries also expose the manmade threats facing the environment today, from raw sewage in India's sacred Ganges River to plastic micro-bead pollution in the Caribbean Sea.

Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules.
